1.  **Most-tested question patterns:** Direct definitions (e.g., Fleming's rules), diagram-based questions (magnetic field lines, electric motor/generator), application-based scenarios (domestic circuits, energy conversions), differentiate between (AC/DC, motor/generator), and reasoning questions on environmental impacts of energy.
